verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing to ask of an analytics SaaS platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no official CLI for Google Analytics 4. The Data and Admin REST APIs, the multi-language client libraries and the web-based Query Explorer are developer building blocks or adjacent tools. The official MCP server belongs to a separate story and does not count as a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
